info.title: Toolshed Hire API
info.description: Rental system for Toolshed Hire. Availability is the allocation of specific tagged assets over half open date periods, enforced by a PostgreSQL GiST exclusion constraint.

get.summary: Report dependency health
get.description:
Report database reachability and the presence of the btree_gist extension.

Returns 200 when everything the application needs is present, and 503 when
it is not, so an uptime check does not have to parse the body to decide
whether the service is usable.

post.summary: Exchange credentials for an access token and a refresh cookie
post.description:
Verify credentials, open a session and issue both tokens.

Raises:
    InvalidCredentials: If the sign in was refused. Mapped to HTTP 401.
    TooManyAttempts: If the caller is throttled. Mapped to HTTP 429.

401.description: The sign in was refused. The body is the same whatever the reason.

429.description: Too many attempts. `Retry-After` carries the wait in seconds.

422.description: Validation Error

post.summary: Exchange the refresh cookie for a new access token and a new cookie
post.description:
Rotate the refresh token and issue a new access token.

Raises:
    SessionExpired: If the cookie is missing or no longer good. Mapped to
        HTTP 401, with the cookie cleared.

401.description: The refresh cookie is missing, unknown, expired, revoked or already used.

403.description: The request named an origin that is not one of the configured ones.

post.summary: Revoke the session of the refresh cookie and clear the cookie
post.description:
Revoke the session the cookie names, if any, and clear the cookie.

The answer is 204 whether or not there was a cookie and whether or not it
named a live session.

403.description: The request named an origin that is not one of the configured ones.

post.summary: Register a customer account and send the verification link
post.description:
Open a customer account, or answer in the same way when the address has one.

Raises:
    ValidationFailure: If a field is refused. HTTP 422, naming the field.
    TooManyAttempts: If the caller is throttled. HTTP 429.

422.description: A field was refused. `errors.fields` names it.

429.description: Too many attempts. `Retry-After` carries the wait in seconds.

post.summary: Prove an email address with the token of a verification link
post.description:
Redeem a verification token. It works once.

Raises:
    VerificationLinkInvalid: If the token is unknown, used or out of
        time. HTTP 400.
    TooManyAttempts: If the caller is throttled. HTTP 429.

400.description: The token is unknown, already used or out of time. The answer is the same for all three.

422.description: A field was refused. `errors.fields` names it.

429.description: Too many attempts. `Retry-After` carries the wait in seconds.

post.summary: Send the signed in account its verification link again
post.description:
Issue a new verification link, or do nothing for a verified account.

Raises:
    TooManyAttempts: If the account is throttled. HTTP 429.

429.description: Too many attempts. `Retry-After` carries the wait in seconds.

post.summary: Ask for a password reset link
post.description:
Send a reset link to an address that has an account, and say nothing either way.

Raises:
    TooManyAttempts: If the caller is throttled. HTTP 429.

422.description: A field was refused. `errors.fields` names it.

429.description: Too many attempts. `Retry-After` carries the wait in seconds.

post.summary: Choose a new password with the token of a reset link
post.description:
Set the new password, end every session of the account and lift any lock.

Raises:
    ResetLinkInvalid: If the token is unknown, used or out of time. HTTP 400.
    ValidationFailure: If the new password is refused. HTTP 422.
    TooManyAttempts: If the caller is throttled. HTTP 429.

400.description: The token is unknown, already used or out of time. The answer is the same for all three.

422.description: A field was refused. `errors.fields` names it.

429.description: Too many attempts. `Retry-After` carries the wait in seconds.

get.summary: Return the signed in account
get.description:
Return the account behind the presented access token.

Args:
    user: The active account, resolved by the layered auth dependencies.
    session: The request scoped session, used to resolve the branch code.
    gateway: The email gateway, asked whether mail to the address would go.

Returns:
    The account, in the shape every session response carries it in.

AuditEventResponse.description: One audit event, as the log shows it.

AvailabilityPageResponse.title: AvailabilityPageResponse
AvailabilityPageResponse.description:
One page of an availability search.

`to` is the day the equipment comes back. It is exclusive, so a unit is
free again on that day.

BalancePaymentRequest.title: BalancePaymentRequest
BalancePaymentRequest.description: The simulated payment of a balance, by the reference the customer was given.

BranchListResponse.description: The active branches, ordered by name.

BranchPositionResponse.title: BranchPositionResponse
BranchPositionResponse.description: Where one trading branch stands today.

CancellationRequest.title: CancellationRequest
CancellationRequest.description: Why a reservation is being cancelled, when the caller wants to say.

CategoryCreateRequest.title: CategoryCreateRequest
CategoryCreateRequest.description: A new category. It starts active, at the top unless a parent is named.

CategoryListResponse.title: CategoryListResponse
CategoryListResponse.description: The active categories, each parent followed by its children.

CategoryResponse.title: CategoryResponse
CategoryResponse.description: One active category. `parentCode` is null for a top level category.

CategoryUpdateRequest.title: CategoryUpdateRequest
CategoryUpdateRequest.description: The fields of a category to change, any of them, and whether it is active.

ChargeResponse.title: ChargeResponse
ChargeResponse.description:
One money line on a rental. A deposit release is a negative amount.

`reversesChargeId` names the charge a reversal undoes. `reason` is the
reason an administrator gave for waiving it, or the reason written on a
reversal or an adjustment, and null on a charge nobody corrected.

ChargeStatus.title: ChargeStatus
ChargeStatus.description: Where a charge stands. A settled charge is never edited (BR-24).

ChargeType.title: ChargeType
ChargeType.description: What a money line on a rental is for. Deposit movements are charges too.

CheckoutCustomerResponse.title: CheckoutCustomerResponse
CheckoutCustomerResponse.description: The customer the equipment is handed to.

CheckoutItemRequest.title: CheckoutItemRequest
CheckoutItemRequest.description: What the counter records about one unit as it goes out.

CheckoutPreviewResponse.title: CheckoutPreviewResponse
CheckoutPreviewResponse.description:
What the counter needs to hand the equipment of a reservation over.

`refusal` is a sentence when `canCheckOut` is false. `rentalId` is set once
the reservation has been collected. `unitsShort` is how many units the
reservation still needs after one was released by hand, and while it is
above zero `canCheckOut` is false and the checkout answers 409.

CheckoutRequest.title: CheckoutRequest
CheckoutRequest.description: Every unit of the reservation, once each, and the customer's signature.

CheckoutUnitResponse.title: CheckoutUnitResponse
CheckoutUnitResponse.description: One unit the reservation holds, as the counter hands it over.

CollectionDueResponse.title: CollectionDueResponse
CollectionDueResponse.description: A confirmed reservation due for collection.

ConditionGrade.title: ConditionGrade
ConditionGrade.description: Condition grade recorded at checkout and return. A is best.

CreateReservationRequest.title: CreateReservationRequest
CreateReservationRequest.description:
A request for a draft reservation.

The period is half open. `to` is the day the equipment comes back and is
not charged. `customerProfileId` is for staff, who book for a named
customer. A customer leaves it null and books for themselves.

CustomerPageResponse.title: CustomerPageResponse
CustomerPageResponse.description: One page of the customers a search found, best match first.

CustomerStatusRequest.title: CustomerStatusRequest
CustomerStatusRequest.description: The standing a customer is to have, and why. The audit event keeps the reason.

CustomerSummaryResponse.title: CustomerSummaryResponse
CustomerSummaryResponse.description:
A customer as the counter sees one.

`email` is null and `hasLogin` is false for a walk-in, who has no account.

CustomerType.title: CustomerType
CustomerType.description: Whether a customer hires as a member of the public or as a trade account.

DamageAssessment.title: DamageAssessment
DamageAssessment.description: Whether a unit that came back still waits for its damage to be assessed.

DamageReportPageResponse.title: DamageReportPageResponse
DamageReportPageResponse.description: One page of damage reports, newest first.

DamageReportRequest.title: DamageReportRequest
DamageReportRequest.description: A damage report as the counter files it.

DamageReportResponse.title: DamageReportResponse
DamageReportResponse.description: One damage report, as staff read it.

DamageSeverity.title: DamageSeverity
DamageSeverity.description:
How bad the damage is, as the counter judged it when the report was filed.

A WRITE_OFF severity does not retire the unit by itself. Only a report the
owner resolves as WRITTEN_OFF does that (BR-38), so the decision to retire
a unit is always the owner's.

DamageStatus.title: DamageStatus
DamageStatus.description: Where a damage report stands between being raised and being closed.

DashboardCountsResponse.title: DashboardCountsResponse
DashboardCountsResponse.description: The true totals behind the dashboard, however long each list is.

DashboardResponse.title: DashboardResponse
DashboardResponse.description: What is due today at one branch. Each list holds at most fifty rows.

DeactivationRequest.title: DeactivationRequest
DeactivationRequest.description: Why an account is being stopped from signing in. The audit event keeps it.

DiaryCollectionResponse.title: DiaryCollectionResponse
DiaryCollectionResponse.description: A reservation starting on a day of the diary.

DiaryResponse.title: DiaryResponse
DiaryResponse.description: The diary of one branch, one entry for each day asked for.

DiaryReturnResponse.title: DiaryReturnResponse
DiaryReturnResponse.description: A rental due back on a day of the diary.

EmailDeliverableResponse.title: EmailDeliverableResponse
EmailDeliverableResponse.description:
Whether a message for the address would be delivered in this environment.

False when the environment only delivers mail to one address and this is
not it. It never depends on whether the address has an account.

GroupBy.title: GroupBy
GroupBy.description: What one line of the report stands for.

HealthResponse.title: HealthResponse
HealthResponse.description: What the health endpoint reports about its own dependencies.

IdDocType.title: IdDocType
IdDocType.description: The identity document a customer presented. Only its last four digits are kept.

LoginRequest.title: LoginRequest
LoginRequest.description:
Credentials posted to the sign in endpoint.

The address is checked structurally rather than with a full RFC 5322
parser. Deliverability is proved by the verification email, not by a
regular expression, so a validation library here would be a dependency
that buys nothing.

The password carries no minimum length. It deliberately did once, and that
was a defect: a wrong password of eleven characters came back as a 422
naming the length rule, while a wrong password of twelve came back as a 401.
That difference is an oracle. It tells an attacker something about the value
they submitted, and it contradicts control C-14 in the security section,
which states that an unknown address and a wrong password are answered
identically in body, status and timing. Length policy applies when a
password is chosen, not when one is presented, so it lives in
`security.hash_password` (BR-45) and not here. The maximum stays, because it
is a property of bcrypt rather than a rule about the account, and it applies
to the unknown address and the wrong password alike.

ModelAvailabilityResponse.title: ModelAvailabilityResponse
ModelAvailabilityResponse.description: Where one model is free for a period, in the quantity asked for.

ModelAvailabilityRowResponse.title: ModelAvailabilityRowResponse
ModelAvailabilityRowResponse.description: One model of an availability search, with an answer from every branch.

ModelCreateRequest.title: ModelCreateRequest
ModelCreateRequest.description: A new product model, with every figure a booking will copy. It starts unpublished.

ModelDetailResponse.title: ModelDetailResponse
ModelDetailResponse.description: A published catalogue entry as its own page shows it.

ModelSortParameter.title: ModelSortParameter
ModelSortParameter.description: The sort orders a request may name.

ModelSummaryResponse.title: ModelSummaryResponse
ModelSummaryResponse.description: A published catalogue entry as it appears in a list.

ModelUpdateRequest.title: ModelUpdateRequest
ModelUpdateRequest.description: The fields of a product model to change, any of them but the SKU.

MonthToDateResponse.title: MonthToDateResponse
MonthToDateResponse.description: Utilisation and gross contribution from the first of the month to the end of today.

NoShowRequest.title: NoShowRequest
NoShowRequest.description: Why nobody collected the reservation, which staff always say.

NotificationPageResponse.title: NotificationPageResponse
NotificationPageResponse.description: One page of the notification log, newest first.

NotificationResponse.title: NotificationResponse
NotificationResponse.description: One notification, as the log shows it.

NotificationStatus.title: NotificationStatus
NotificationStatus.description: Delivery outcome of a notification. A FAILED row can be sent again.

NotificationType.title: NotificationType
NotificationType.description: What an outbound message is about. Phase one sends one kind only.

OverdueRentalResponse.title: OverdueRentalResponse
OverdueRentalResponse.description: A rental past its due date with a unit still out, and the late fee it has run up.

PasswordResetCompletionRequest.title: PasswordResetCompletionRequest
PasswordResetCompletionRequest.description: The token of a reset link and the password chosen with it.

PasswordResetRequest.title: PasswordResetRequest
PasswordResetRequest.description: The address a reset link is asked for.

ProblemDetail.title: ProblemDetail
ProblemDetail.description:
An RFC 9457 problem document.

`type` is a stable slug, not a resolvable URL, because this API is not a
public specification and inventing a documentation URL that does not exist
is worse than a slug that does.

`requestId` is an extension member. It is the same value as the
`X-Request-ID` response header and the `request_id` on every log record of
the request, so a caller who quotes it has named the exact log lines.

ProfileResponse.title: ProfileResponse
ProfileResponse.description:
A customer's own details.

`accountStatus`, `tradeDiscountPercent` and `noShowCount` are shown and
cannot be changed by the customer.

ProfileUpdateRequest.title: ProfileUpdateRequest
ProfileUpdateRequest.description:
The contact and billing fields a customer may change, each of them optional.

A field that is left out is left alone. `companyName` and `vatNumber` may
be sent as null or as an empty string to clear them.

PublicationRequest.title: PublicationRequest
PublicationRequest.description: Whether the model is to be in the public catalogue.

QuoteBasis.title: QuoteBasis
QuoteBasis.description: Which of the two totals a quote charged for one unit, as a response spells it.

QuoteResponse.title: QuoteResponse
QuoteResponse.description:
What a hire will cost.

`totalIncVat` is the hire charge. The deposit is not in it, because a
deposit is held and returned and not charged. `vatAmount` is worked out on
the subtotal after the discount.

ReasonRequest.title: ReasonRequest
ReasonRequest.description: The reason an administrator gives for an override.

RegisterRequest.title: RegisterRequest
RegisterRequest.description:
What a person sends to open a customer account.

Only the last four characters of the identity document are sent. The full
number never reaches the service.

RentalItemResponse.title: RentalItemResponse
RentalItemResponse.description:
One unit on a rental.

`daysLateToday` and `lateFeeToday` are what the late fee would be if the
unit came back today, worked out on the server. `replacementValue` is the
value copied onto the booking line, the most a damage report may recover,
and is null for a customer, as `assetTag` is.

RentalResponse.title: RentalResponse
RentalResponse.description: One rental, as the caller is allowed to see it.

RentalStatus.title: RentalStatus
RentalStatus.description: Rental lifecycle status, governed by BR-29, BR-52 and BR-53.

ReportDefinitionsResponse.title: ReportDefinitionsResponse
ReportDefinitionsResponse.description: The two definitions every figure of the report is read by.

ReportFiguresResponse.title: ReportFiguresResponse
ReportFiguresResponse.description: The figures of a line of the report, or of every line together.

ReportLineResponse.title: ReportLineResponse
ReportLineResponse.description:
One line of the report, for an asset, a model, a category or a branch.

`assetTag` and `status` are set on a line for an asset. `branchCode` is set
on a line for an asset or a branch, `categoryName` on a line for an asset,
a model or a category, and `modelName` on a line for an asset or a model.

ReservationLineRequest.title: ReservationLineRequest
ReservationLineRequest.description: One model and how many of it.

ReservationLineResponse.title: ReservationLineResponse
ReservationLineResponse.description: One line of a reservation, with the rates it was priced at.

ReservationPageResponse.title: ReservationPageResponse
ReservationPageResponse.description: One page of reservations, newest first.

ReservationResponse.title: ReservationResponse
ReservationResponse.description:
One reservation, as the caller is allowed to see it.

`subtotalExVat` is the hire after the trade discount, and `vatAmount` is
worked out on it, so the two add up to `estimatedTotalIncVat`. The deposit
is not in that total, because a deposit is held and given back.

ReservationStatus.title: ReservationStatus
ReservationStatus.description: Reservation lifecycle status, governed by the State pattern in the domain.

ResolutionRequest.title: ResolutionRequest
ResolutionRequest.description: How an administrator closes a report.

ReturnDueResponse.title: ReturnDueResponse
ReturnDueResponse.description: A rental due back today with a unit still out.

ReturnItemRequest.title: ReturnItemRequest
ReturnItemRequest.description: What the counter records about one unit as it comes back.

ReturnRequest.title: ReturnRequest
ReturnRequest.description: One or more units of a rental that came back.

SettlementWait.title: SettlementWait
SettlementWait.description: What a rental is waiting on before its deposit can be settled.

StaffCreateRequest.title: StaffCreateRequest
StaffCreateRequest.description:
A new staff account. The person chooses their own password through the link they are sent.

`branchCode` is required for counter staff and must be null for an administrator.

StaffCreatedResponse.title: StaffCreatedResponse
StaffCreatedResponse.description:
A new staff account, and whether the email with the link to choose a password was taken.

`emailDeliverable` is false when the message could not be handed to the
email provider. The person then asks for a new link from the sign in page
once mail reaches them.

StaffUpdateRequest.title: StaffUpdateRequest
StaffUpdateRequest.description: The fields of a staff account to change, any of them. Never the address or a password.

TokenRequest.title: TokenRequest
TokenRequest.description: The token of a verification link.

TokenResponse.title: TokenResponse
TokenResponse.description:
The access token and the account it belongs to.

Signing in and refreshing both return this. The refresh token is not in
it. That travels in a cookie the page cannot read.

UnitQuoteResponse.title: UnitQuoteResponse
UnitQuoteResponse.description:
What one unit costs for the period, and how that was arrived at.

`basis` is `weekly` when the complete weeks at the weekly rate and the
days left over at the daily rate came to less than every day at the daily
rate, and `daily` otherwise.

UserResponse.title: UserResponse
UserResponse.description:
The signed in account, as every session response and `/api/me` return it.

`branchCode` is null unless the account is counter staff.

`emailDeliverable` is false when this environment would not hand a message
for the account's address to the email provider, because email is off or
because mail goes to one approved address and this is not it. It is the
same rule the account routes answer with, and it depends on the
configuration and the address alone. A screen reads it so that it never
promises a confirmation email that cannot arrive.

UserRole.title: UserRole
UserRole.description: The single role carried by a UserAccount. A role is never a set.

UtilisationReportResponse.title: UtilisationReportResponse
UtilisationReportResponse.description: One page of the report, highest gross contribution first, with the totals over every line.

WalkInRequest.title: WalkInRequest
WalkInRequest.description:
What the counter records to register a customer who has no login.

`branchCode` is for an administrator, who belongs to no branch. Counter
staff may leave it out, and the customer is registered at their branch.
`companyName` is required for a trade customer.
